weights_scope: verify hashes each actual checkpoint payload; portable verifies metadata and sidecars only
source_selection: Earliest timezone-aware completed_at among valid complete matched cells; never score-based. All valid duplicates and their costs retained.

definitions.units: Proportions in JSON; percentages/percentage points in Markdown
definitions.attack_detection: P(predicted any attack | true any attack), support-weighted binary detection
definitions.attack_guard: Macro recall over attack families with test support >=20; excluded families remain in MF1/BAcc/per-class tables
definitions.closure: Mean of all paired seed ratios (FPR_Replay-FPR_method)/(FPR_Replay-FPR_Joint); signed denominators retained; zero is undefined
definitions.memory_scope: M=200*seen includes retained training replay and validation; matched permanent holdout, with explicitly permitted seen training-archive access; not strict no-history streaming
definitions.scope: Section26 matched-holdout experiments only; not an OFRA repair or overall RQ1/RQ3/innovation closure
